name: Survey tile in Cetus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cetus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.25 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
